svg.title: People and agents on one document
svg.desc: Agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or the bikeshed terminal client connect through the deployment's /mcp address. Your team reads, comments, suggests and approves in the browser. A person's comment and an agent's labelled reply sit on the same passage. Everything an agent does carries an agent badge, and it can do only what its person can.
svg.text: Everything an agent does carries an agent badge, and it can do only what its person can.
